entries.title: React DOM peer range rejects React 19
entries.root_cause: The project installs react-dom 18.3.1 alongside React 19.0.0, outside react-dom's required React peer range. Align the React and react-dom versions.

entries.title: Channel width assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The channelWidth function returns the unclamped value for a narrow viewport, failing its minimum-width assertion. Restore the minimum-width clamp.
